text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japanese Derby, and Grass
Wonder
is set for her clash with El
Condor Pasa.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's tense, knowing that if she can't
overcome
her contemporary rivals,
defeating the "Beast"
will remain no
more than a dream.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
One thing's for sure—we're in for an
intense
Derby this year!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
